name: Flat-lay zhora
summary: Pohľad kolmo zhora na aranžovanú plochu. Ukáže šírku sortimentu alebo kontext použitia bez toho, aby vznikol vizuálny chaos.
when_to_use: Sety, balíčky, viac produktov naraz, sezónne kompozície. Pozor: viac než 3 až 4 objekty už znižujú výkon.
prompt_block: Render the image as a top-down flat-lay photograph shot perpendicular to the surface, with no perspective distortion and no visible horizon. Objects are arranged on a plain matte surface with generous negative space and a clear compositional grid. Lighting is soft and even from above with short, soft shadows falling consistently in one direction. Keep the arrangement deliberately sparse: the hero product is largest and centred or set on a third, supporting objects are smaller and never overlap the hero label. Colour palette is restrained and tonal. Every object lies flat on the surface; nothing floats or stands upright.
never: more than four objects in frame
objects overlapping the hero product label
busy patterned surfaces or fabric clutter
